lines.hook: EA FC 27 rates thirteen players aged twenty-one or under at eighty-one or higher. Checked against the football, six cards hold up. Seven don't.
items: Luka Vušković, eighty-one. Fair: Brighton's club-record signing, and a Premier League starter.
Dean Huijsen, eighty-one. Fair: a regular at Real Madrid.
Robin Risser, eighty-one. Fair: Ligue One's goalkeeper of last season.
Kobbie Mainoo, eighty-one. Too low: September's player of the month at United.
Victor Froholdt, eighty-two. Too low: in September, the most valuable player outside the big five leagues.
Arda Güler, eighty-three. Wrong position: carded on the right, playing as Madrid's ten.
Nico O'Reilly, eighty-three. Fair: Manchester City's first-choice left-back last season.
Warren Zaïre-Emery, eighty-three. Wrong position: carded in midfield, used at full-back.
Yan Diomande, eighty-four, up eighteen. Generous, for now: a rating for the Leipzig season.
Kenan Yıldız, eighty-four. Fair rating, but a ten on the card, a winger on the pitch.
Désiré Doué, eighty-six. Generous in September, earned in October: three goals in seven days.
Pau Cubarsí, eighty-six. Fair: the World Cup's best young player.
And the game's number one: Lamine Yamal, ninety. Fair: seven league goals, five assists by the twelfth of October.
